workarounds.symptom: update: after a daemon restart, cotal update refuses with 'hosted Manager is starting' forever while daemon status and setup read answering
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(daemon): allow complete hosted manager status observations. Target files: bin/daemon/client.ts, bin/daemon/manager.ts, bin/daemon/update-entry.ts. The machine daemon observed each hosted Manager with one 3.5 second bound around the whole probe: caller credential exchange, broker admission, contract resolution and the status request. On a link with about 150 ms of round-trip time that probe takes longer, so the daemon wrote `starting` and threw away the answer that arrived afterwards. Everything that reads the daemon's rec... (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/6271)

workarounds.symptom: cli update --self: fails with a raw npm 404 for the first minutes after a release, while a dependency's tarball is not served yet
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): check the release's archives are served before self-update installs. Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/command-kernel.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/update.ts, .changeset/check-update-release-archives.md. For the first minutes after a release, `cotal update --self` could fail with a raw npm 404: the registry already named the new version as `latest` for `cotal-ai` while the tarball of a package it depends on was not served yet. Nothing was damaged, but the person upgrading saw "install failed" with... (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/6255)

workarounds.symptom: run ps: a Manager newer than the space's auth service fails with a raw broker permission error instead of naming the version gap
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(runtime): explain a missing run-list grant from an older auth service. Target files: implementations/runtime/smoke/run-command.smoke.ts, implementations/runtime/src/run-host.ts, .changeset/run-list-auth-upgrade.md. `cotal run ps` against a Manager from 0.149.0 on, in a space whose auth service is older, failed with the broker's raw text: `Permissions Violation for Publish to "$JS.API.DIRECT.GET.KV_cotal_records_<space>"`.
